title: Scuffleball: browser multiplayer pixel soccer built with Claude Code and PixelLab
author: nordic-god
selftext:
The trailer is actual gameplay: Remotion drives the game's own renderer through bot matches.

Claude Code wrote most of the code(almost all tbh). It only became reliable after I made the simulation strictly deterministic and had ESLint enforce it, which is what made rollback netcode work. PixelLab made the characters as 64×64 animation frames, and each team's kit colours are swapped in at runtime, so one sprite set covers every team. It took a bit to get the art direction right and game feel was the part AI couldn't do. Tuning kicks and slides was all playtesting.

Free in the browser: https://scuffleball.com/. Ask me anything about the pipeline.
